editionLabel: Artipia Games English base-game rulebook, 2023 edition
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went stargazing starts. The rulebook also accepts another way of choosing the first player.
clarifications: Starting with that player, place player-order markers in clockwise order on the Player Order track.
This is the multiplayer setup; the Automa has its own separate rulebook.
